nodes.name: Read Reviews CSV
nodes.notes: Alternative: Use 'Google Sheets' node to read from Google Sheets instead of local CSV

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  summary->>'total_reviews' as total_reviews,
  summary->>'sentiment_distribution' as sentiment_dist,
  summary->>'priority_distribution' as priority_dist,
  summary->>'top_topics' as top_topics,
  summary->>'top_complaints' as top_complaints
FROM input
